longDescription:
Nestopia is a cycle-accurate NES/Famicom emulator. It has a high compatibility rate and support for many peripherals and input devices.

Features:

  • Save states
  • Movie recording
  • Game rewinding
  • GUI or command line interface
  • Emulation of NTSC, PAL, and Dendy systems
  • Support for NES Zapper games
  • Support for Famicom Disk System games
